capture_source: live capture 2026-08-28 at the transport seam, contributed via issue #25; SAP S/4HANA 2023 kernel 793 release 758, unicode. RFC_GET_FUNCTION_INTERFACE for RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN, which is not remote-enabled on that release. Already sanitised by the probe script: GW conversation handle and 0x0514 session token overwritten, byte length preserved. No NI length prefix.
evidence: the same shape appears on kernel 742 for CNV_MBT_SHELL_GET_CLIENTS; both raise AbapApplicationError with identical message coordinates
notes: An ABAP exception reply carries NO 0x0420 return code. A reader that only checks the return code therefore sees no error at all - which is how a non-RFC-enabled function module produced an empty FunctionDesc and no diagnostic, and every later call rejected the caller's arguments as unknown (issue #25).

Tag mapping confirmed here and by two other live exceptions: 0x0415 message class, 0x0416 message type, 0x0417 message number (also the marker that this is an exception at all), 0x0411 first message variable, 0x0401 exception name.
FL/046/FU_NOT_FOUND is the standard 'function module not found or not remote-enabled' message; 0x0411 echoes the function module name that was asked for.
